text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking through town with Manhattan Cafe
while avoiding the lingering sunset rays—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
There's... a crowd ahead...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
You there, Trainer,
wanna try your luck?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...The raffle...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there was one more!?
Y-Young lady, you should try too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking down at my right hand...
I found a single raffle ticket clutched in it.
I have no memory of pulling it out, though...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would you like to draw one...?
Surely this must be some kind of fate...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Urged on, we grip the lever together.
The raffle drum, spinning like the gears of fate, begins to turn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A hot spring... trip voucher...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring... Visiting an inn nestled in the mountains, soaking in the bath,
and then... and then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......Just sleeping?
choice_data_list: No, things like having meals and chatting.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is... true...
If I'm not alone, I can do that too.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...With your 'friend'?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We don't need a ticket for my "friend,"
right? What are you saying...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was met with a puzzled look.
For now, as I tried to hand over the ticket I had received...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had vanished from my hand!
Where on earth did it...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much.
You'll hold onto it for me, then?
Until that day comes when we can take our time.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure not to lose it.
Well, even if you did... it feels like it would just
find its way back to your pocket anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket"
was safely tucked into my pocket.
I should make sure to keep this lucky ticket safe.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"...
You won something pretty amazing, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look.
There is a carrot stuck in the hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how cute.
It's almost as if—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's like a "tombstone" on top of a hill.
A forgotten... someone's grave...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Let us partake while letting our thoughts wander.
I wonder what kind of person lies asleep here."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while saying something slightly surreal,
Manhattan Cafe looks happy.
Afterwards, the two of us enjoyed the delicious treat together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Carrots... That's quite a lot...
I'm happy to receive them, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Eating this much will give me an upset stomach...
Trainer, how about we wait
until tomorrow to eat this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The next day, there'll be fewer skewers left,
right? If it's just that much, I think I could
finish them all without a problem.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Did I say something strange?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as told, the two of us ate them the next day.
As for how many skewers there were... I didn't have the courage to count.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Carrots... Just one solitary carrot...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but there might be no need to despair.
I have heard an allegory like this before...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Just a single carrot. But when the villager buried it in the ground with a wish, lo and behold...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Its roots spread throughout the earth like a vast network,
and carrots began sprouting all across the village.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The villagers were overjoyed. Yet no matter how much they ate, they couldn't finish it all. They ate and ate, but—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Before long, the orange woods completely engulfed the village, piercing the sky like spires, and then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"That carrot... will you plant it in the field once you get home?
Or will you eat it right up?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hurriedly, the two of us split it in half and stuffed our cheeks.
It wasn't much, but it still felt like a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Tissues...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Shall I burn it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Breathe life into it and make it move?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so?
Then it really is just an ordinary tissue.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Used... and simply thrown away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is she disappointed...?
An unreadable shadow fell over
Manhattan Cafe's face.
